Search matches whole words, so a search for âinvoiceâ misses a file that only says âinvoicesâ. Before each search, the Shlexball app adds the singular and plural of every topic word. FindBench is Shlexball's file search benchmark: 312 plain English requests the model never saw in training. Each model turns a request into a search. That search runs on a test folder holding the right files plus decoys that look similar. A test passes only if exactly the right files come back: nothing missing, nothing extra.
